regime.title: HIPAA Security Rule, 45 CFR 164.312 — technical safeguards (US HHS)
regime.determination_by: the covered entity or business associate, and HHS

source.note: ecfr.gov, govinfo.gov and law.cornell.edu were unreachable when this map was written; clause numbers follow common citation and are unverified; requirement text is our paraphrase

rows.requirement: Mechanisms record and examine activity in systems that hold or use ePHI.
rows.mechanism: Append-only, hash-chained, device-signed receipt ledgers record every custody act.

rows.requirement: Mechanisms record and examine activity in systems that hold or use ePHI.
rows.mechanism: A read-only FHIR R4-shaped AuditEvent projection of the receipts, for a SIEM.

rows.requirement: Policies and procedures protect ePHI from improper alteration or destruction.
rows.mechanism: Hash-chained, device-signed ledgers, checked by three implementations (as Part 11 row 11.10(a)-integrity).
rows.limits: The policies and procedures are the covered entity's; this row maps the integrity mechanism they rely on. The ledgers detect improper alteration or destruction; they do not prevent it.

rows.requirement: Electronic mechanisms corroborate that ePHI has not been altered or destroyed without authorization.
rows.mechanism: The sealed chain's integrity check, under a pinned device key.
rows.limits: Whether a deployment's records are ePHI is the covered entity's determination; SecuraCV records no ePHI by design.

rows.requirement: A person or entity seeking access is authenticated as the one claimed.
rows.mechanism: Trustee keys and the device seed authenticate custody acts; who holds them is the deployment's.
rows.operator_action: Authenticate the people who hold seeds and trustee keys.
